subject: Vendr onboarding: ephemeral credential orchestration & CAIQ fragment plan
messages:
From: Lena Ortiz <lena@vendr.com>
To: soojin_lee@redwood.example.com
Cc: onboard@vendr.com
Date: Thu, 20 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Vendr onboarding — ephemeral credentials & CAIQ fragments

Hi Soojin,

Great to meet (virtually) last week. Wanted to kick off the technical piece for portal onboarding. Two items from our side that will speed the profile build: a) confirmation on how Redwood wants to advertise short-lived credentials (S3 uploads, presigned URLs, or API ingest) and b) a mapping of which CAIQ sections you want us to pre-fill vs provide as attachments (fragments).

We typically issue ephemeral API keys for upload tooling that expire in 1 hour — our security team prefers that model, but we can support a presigned S3 flow as well. Attached is a suggested orchestration diagram and a small CAIQ fragment spreadsheet (redwood-caiq-fragments-v1.xlsx) that highlights optional vs required pieces.

Can you confirm preferred temporary credential flow and an initial owner for CAIQ fragments? If you want, we can schedule a 30-minute sync this week to walk through.

Thanks,
Lena Ortiz
Vendor Onboarding Lead — Vendr

Attachment: tempcred-orchestration-diagram.png (image/png)
Attachment: redwood-caiq-fragments-v1.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet)

From: soojin_lee@redwood.example.com
To: Lena Ortiz <lena@vendr.com>
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.example.com, marissa_cole@redwood.example.com
Date: Thu, 20 May 2027 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Vendr onboarding — ephemeral credentials & CAIQ fragments

Lena,

Thanks — this is helpful. Short answers:
- We prefer ephemeral API keys for the initial ingest (token rotation enforced by our platform) for the staging window; presigned S3 is acceptable for bulk evidence bundles but we'd like those URLs limited to 6 hours.
- Redwood will own the CAIQ fragment gating: our security team will review and then push any editable fragments back into the portal.

Cc'ing Ben and Marissa — Ben will coordinate the evidence manifest and Marissa will drive CAIQ mapping with your security team.

- Action: Ben, can you confirm whether our temp key generator (service: evidence-uploader) can mint 1-hour keys for Vendr's agents?
- Action: Marissa, please scan the attached CAIQ fragments and flag any rows that look like we should require vendor-supplied proof vs internal statement.

If convenient, let's do a 30-minute sync Friday 11:00am PT.

Best,
Soojin Lee
Vendor Security Intake — Redwood Inference

Quoted message below.

From: ben_carter@redwood.example.com

Date: Fri, 21 May 2027 08:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Vendr onboarding — ephemeral credentials & CAIQ fragments

Team,

We can mint 1-hour keys from evidence-uploader. Two implementation notes:
1) The current service issues keys tied to an agent id and an allowed-upload-prefix; we should restrict the prefix to a vendor-specific staging bucket path to avoid cross-tenant exposure.
2) We need Vendr to sign an ingest SLA for retention and TTL on the staging artifacts; otherwise we automatically expire and delete after 7 days.

I'll prepare a short playbook for Vendr that shows: get-temp-key -> upload evidence -> notify intake webhook -> auto-scan (sig/caiq) -> move to long-term S3. That can be an internal doc but we'll share a sanitized version with Vendr. Attaching the evidence-inventory-shortlist.pdf draft.

Ben Carter
Program Manager, Security Integrations — Redwood Inference

Attachment: evidence-inventory-shortlist.pdf (application/pdf)

From: Lena Ortiz <lena@vendr.com>
To: ben_carter@redwood.example.com, soojin_lee@redwood.example.com
Cc: security@vendr.com
Date: Mon, 24 May 2027 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Vendr onboarding — ephemeral credentials & CAIQ fragments

Thanks Ben — that flow looks good from our side. A couple questions from Security:
- Can the temp keys be scoped so uploads only land in a 'staging/vendor_<vendor_id>/' prefix?
- Will your auto-scan produce a CAIQ fragment manifest we can consume to mark sections as 'vendor-supplied' vs 'redwood-supplied'?

Security has also asked for a short retention addendum — if documents are only needed for a QA sweep and can be deleted after 7 days, will Redwood redact any PII before moving to long-term storage?

We can do Friday 11:00am PT — I've added onboard@vendr.com to the invite.

Best,
Lena

> On Fri, 21 May 2027 at 08:22, ben_carter@redwood.example.com wrote:
> > Team, we can mint 1-hour keys...

From: marissa_cole@redwood.example.com
To: Lena Ortiz <lena@vendr.com>, ben_carter@redwood.example.com, soojin_lee@redwood.example.com
Date: Tue, 25 May 2027 11:40:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Vendr onboarding — ephemeral credentials & CAIQ fragments

Lena / Security team,

I reviewed the CAIQ fragment spreadsheet and flagged rows that need vendor-supplied evidence (NDA, TLS cert scans, SOC2 report pointer). Our ask: please attach SOC2 cover page and the TLS scan report for the production endpoints; for staging uploads it's fine to provide signed checksums.

Regarding PII — our default is to redact PII before long-term retention. For the staging window we can accept raw artifacts but they will be auto-scrubbed by the evidence pipeline prior to archival. If you have anything that cannot be programmatically redacted, please mark it and we'll follow up.

I'll circulate a sanitized CAIQ fragment manifest after the sync.

Marissa Cole
Security Operations — Redwood Inference

> On Mon, 24 May 2027 at 09:15, Lena Ortiz <lena@vendr.com> wrote:
> > Thanks Ben — that flow looks good...

From: soojin_lee@redwood.example.com
To: Lena Ortiz <lena@vendr.com>, onboard@vendr.com
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.example.com, marissa_cole@redwood.example.com, rishi_malhotra@redwood.example.com
Date: Tue, 25 May 2027 15:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Vendr onboarding — ephemeral credentials & CAIQ fragments

Perfect — thanks all for the clarifications. Quick summary and next steps:

- Decision: Ephemeral API keys for ingest (1-hour TTL) + presigned S3 (max 6 hour) for bulk bundles. Keys will be scoped to staging/vendor_449/ prefix. (Ben to provision.)
- CAIQ: Marissa will publish a sanitized fragment manifest. Vendr to attach SOC2 cover page and TLS scan to flagged rows.
- Retention: Redwood will auto-scrub PII during pipeline ingest; staging artifacts deleted after 7 days unless a retention exception is signed.
- Action items:
  * Ben: share the temp-key minting playbook and the sanitized uploader flow (ETA: 48 hours).
  * Marissa: publish fragment manifest post-sync (ETA: EOD Wed).
  * Lena/Vendr: upload SOC2 cover page + TLS scan to the staging path and confirm when done.

I'll follow up with the calendar invite and a short one-page summary for your security reviewer. Thanks for moving quickly on this — should be a straightforward onboarding.

Regards,
Soojin Lee
Vendor Security Intake — Redwood Inference
